answer: Trusted issuers grant 100 unit slots as a scarce capacity reservation, ensuring each agent holds one active occupancy window. The verifier monitors these slots, and any attempt to clone an identity is met with immediate cancellation. A secure vault stores the agent registration, while a deep canyon simulation test checks for duplicate latency patterns. An honest agent pays 1 unit for its slot, whereas a sybil farm incurs 1,000 units to bypass the reef of anti-collision checks. Because slots occupy exclusive server time, parallel pool execution cannot amortize these reservation costs.
